storage.description: A structured approach to defining, documenting, and maintaining clear, consistent capability statements for systems, services, and organizations to ensure understanding, traceability, and alignment across stakeholders.
storage.name: Capability Declarations
principles: Clarity and Precision: Capability statements must be unambiguous and specific, avoiding vague or overly broad language.
Consistency and Standardization: Use uniform terminology, formatting, and classification schemes across all declarations.
Traceability and Maintainability: Ensure each capability can be traced to its source, versioned, and easily updated as requirements evolve.
